system_configurations.name: RCCL-Validate-MI455X-TDM-SIMPLE-Reduce
system_configurations.description: Functional validation of the gfx1250 TDM SIMPLE reduce path. Builds with --enable-tdm-simple, sets RCCL_TDM_SIMPLE_REDUCE_ENABLE=1 and runs the reducing collectives of the unit suite under forced SIMPLE on Ring and Tree, mirroring the full_pow2_ring_simple and full_pow2_tree_simple categories in test/test_categories.yaml.

tests.name: TDM_Reduce_Ring_AllReduce
tests.description: AllReduce under forced Ring + SIMPLE with the TDM reduce path enabled

tests.name: TDM_Reduce_Ring_GroupCall
tests.description: Grouped collectives, including reductions, under forced Ring + SIMPLE

tests.name: TDM_Reduce_Tree_AllReduce
tests.description: AllReduce under forced Tree + SIMPLE with the TDM reduce path enabled

tests.name: TDM_Reduce_Ring_AllReduce_UserBufferRegistration
tests.description: Registered user buffers under forced Ring + SIMPLE, where the TDM reduce reads peer buffers directly with the system-scope cache policy

tests.name: TDM_Capability
tests.description: Fails when the SDK cannot build the tensor data mover, which would otherwise compile the TDM reduce path away and leave the suites below covering nothing

tests.name: TDM_Reduce_PathCompiledIn
tests.description: Fails when --enable-tdm-simple did not reach the build or the device pass, which would leave every suite below exercising the vector path under a TDM-named config

tests.name: TDM_Reduce_Device
tests.description: reduceCopy with the TDM reduce switch on and off against a host reference, including the TDM gate's decision, pre-op and post-op handling, and the fallback cases

test_suites.name: TDM SIMPLE Reduce - Toolchain capability
test_suites.description: Guards the suites below: a build without tensor-data-mover support makes them vacuous

test_suites.name: TDM SIMPLE Reduce - Ring
test_suites.description: Reducing collectives under forced Ring + SIMPLE on a TDM-enabled build

test_suites.name: TDM SIMPLE Reduce - Tree
test_suites.description: AllReduce under forced Tree + SIMPLE on a TDM-enabled build

test_suites.name: TDM SIMPLE Reduce - Registered user buffers
test_suites.description: Registered-buffer cases under forced Ring + SIMPLE, covering the system-scope cache policy
